description: Fork of exp353 (β1=0.9, lut_lr=1e-3, noise=0, all-soft). Adds inter-table cosine-similarity contrastive loss across LUT modules: for each LUT, penalize squared off-diagonal cosine similarity between flattened table weights, scaled by lambda=0.01. Goal: (a) push tables to learn diverse functions, (b) give every LUT weight a DENSE gradient signal every step (the contrast loss is differentiable through all rows), partially addressing the per-row sparsity bottleneck. References: exp353 partial (killed @ 2400 = 1.7575); exp352 baseline = 1.6302.
